g.title: Pico
g.text: USB to the Mac for power, flashing, and serial. 3V3(OUT) is pin 36, VSYS pin 39.

g.title: ILI9341
g.text: Backlight LED pin straight to 3V3. SDO (MISO) stays unconnected. MADCTL 0x28 in firmware; try 0xE8 if mirrored.

g.title: VEML7700
g.text: Breakout has its own pull-ups. Firmware tolerates it absent (lux reads -1).

g.title: MAX98357A
g.text: MAX98357A I2S 3 W class-D amp breakout
VIN accepts 2.5 to 5.5 V; 3V3 is quiet and safe, VSYS (pin 39) is louder. GAIN and SD left open (9 dB, enabled).

g.title: Button
g.text: Firmware enables the internal pull-up; pressed reads low.

g.title: LED
g.text: PIP_RGB_COMMON_ANODE 1 in config.h if yours is common anode (then COM goes to 3V3).
